dataset.title: Elva Municipality Diagnosis Dataset

dataset.description:
The data in this dataset is derived from the study presented in the 11th International Conference on Energy and Sustainability (september 2025), to be publicated in the volume of WIT Transactions on Ecology and the Environment.

This geospatial dataset refers to the solar resource assessment on the drOp project in Ermua (Spain), in particular in the pilot neighbourhood of Santa Ana, and the photovoltaics (PV) deployment potential on roofs. The dataset is composed by one raster layer and one vectorial layer:

  • solar resource Santa Ana.tif

    Solar resource raster file with 1m x 1m spatial resolution, assessing the annual global radiation over surface (considering the current slope and aspect of each point), expressed on kWh/m2·year

  • PV potential Santa Ana.geojson

    Rooftop PV potential of each building in Santa Ana neighbourhood built over cadastral geometry (vectorial file). Solar resource values have been crosschecked with neighbourhood's roofs, filtering the useful surfaces based on determined slope, aspect and radiation thresholds. Each building include the following KPIs:

    •  "Roof area [m2]": area of the building footprint based on cadastral geometry

    • "Aver. Rad [kWh/m2year]": annual global solar radiation on surface (average value for the whole area)

    • "Useful area for PV [m2]": considered useful area for PV surface once geometry and practicity restrictions have been applied

    • "Aver. Rad on useful area [kWh/m2year]": annual global solar radiation on the useful PV surface

    • "PV power [kW]": potential PV power that could be installed in the useful surface with an average market module (2024)

    • "Elect. Generation[kWh/year]": achievable average annual renewable electricity production

    • "Saved emissions [kgCO2/year]": achievable average annual equivalent CO2 emissions saving

dataset.description:
This dataset contains the information used in the  drOp project (Digitally enabled social district renovation processes for age-friendly environments driving social innovation and local economic development. Num.101080025) to build a multidimensional characterization of Ermua and the Santa Ana neighbourhood through relevant indicators, and its visualisation in a Geographic Information System (GIS) by analysing statistical data, as well as other urban and social data available

This study was presented in deliverable  D1.2 Diagnosis and baseline of Santa Ana neighbourhood (WP1) of the drOp project

format:
The data includes geospatial information and files. The file formats available in this dataset are .qgz (zip file for QGD data- sqlite data), .cpg (ESRI Shapefile code specification file), .dbf (dbase database file), .shp (geometric data file), .shx (shape files for shp files), .sbn (spatial index file), .sbx and .qmd (Markdown documents).
In addition there are xlsx, tif, pdf and prj files.
There are also spreadsheets and ppt presentations.

dataset.description:
This repository contains a comprehensive set of datasets related to a smart city co-creation project, organized into several distinct folders. The project drOp is call drOp and has been funded by the European Union under the Grant Agreement number 101080025 — drOp. The title of the project is "Digitally enabled social district renovation processes for age-friendly environments driving socialinnovation and local economic development".  The main objective of drOp is to provide an integrated renovation methodology (IRM) that at a strategic level is intended to transform social housing districts into inclusive smart neighbourhoods (more energy efficient, accessible and liveable). 

This methodology will lead the actions to improve: urban space, the accessibility of the neighborhood and the quality of life of all the inhabitants, and to guarantee the connectivity of neighbourhoods in all areas: physical, social and digital.
Two main drivers will be considered: social innovation and local economic development.
 
The repository is divided into four folders. Each folder contains specific types of data, from community engagement metrics to technical energy assessments. The content for each folder is summarised next. Additional information about the files is provided the readme.md files in each folder.
 
1. **Ermua Participation and Cocreation Process** 
    This folder contains a comprehensive collection of documents detailing citizen participation and the outcomes of co-creation activities.
Includes activities, participation, surveys, KPI, etc. This folders points to another dataset for local economic development that is available in Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/records/15424161).
More detail on the content of the folder in the Readme.md inside.
 
2. **Ermua Smart City Context**
    This folder contains technical and social data related to the project's energy and urban rehabilitation initiatives.
This folders points to another dataset for the local energy community that is available in Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/records/17185620). More detail on the content of the folder in the Readme.md inside.
 
3.  **Dissemination and Communication**
    This folder stores information about the project's online presence, dissemination efforts and communication effectiveness. More detail on the content of the folder in the Readme.md inside.
 
4.  **Elva Replication Workshop Feedback**
    This folder contains a summary of anonymized feedback collected from surveys in Elva, Estonia. More detail on the content of the folder in the Readme.md inside.
